picks.title: ComfyUI ships an official MCP server — Claude or Codex can now build and repair your node graphs
picks.excerpt: ComfyUI shipped an official MCP server, so Claude or Codex can build, run and repair ComfyUI graphs while the filmmaker keeps the creative half. Walks through what agent-driven node graphs mean for a solo AI-video pipeline.
picks.rationale: The single most actionable item in the pool: an official MCP server means the node-wrangling half of a ComfyUI pipeline can be handed to an agent today.

picks.title: Adobe Firefly's Generate Music, Speech and Sound Effects go GA, with a free tier for the AI Assistant
picks.excerpt: Adobe pushed Firefly's Generate Music, Generate Speech and Generate Sound Effects to general availability, added more third-party AI models and opened Firefly AI Assistant in a free tier. Sound-post relevance: score, VO and SFX generation now sit inside the same tool video editors already use.
picks.rationale: Score, VO and SFX generation leave beta inside the suite editors already pay for — temp-track and scratch-VO work changes on Monday.

picks.title: Eddie AI trains an editing model small enough to run locally, claims a 47% win rate against Kimi K3
picks.excerpt: Eddie AI says its purpose-built 9B editing model hit a 47% win rate against Kimi K3 while being small enough to run on-premises, pointing at private, personalized assembly-edit assistants for post houses.
picks.rationale: A 9B assembly-edit model that runs on-prem is the first credible answer for post houses whose clients forbid uploading footage to a cloud LLM.

picks.title: MetaBull acquires Inkrise and its deterministic AIR rendering engine, names Aaron Simpson head of production
picks.excerpt: AI-animation studio Inkrise folds into MetaBull Labs, taking its Felix pipeline tool and deterministic AIR rendering engine with it. MetaBull argues deterministic rendering from layout, storyboard and animation data holds character and narrative continuity that text-to-video models cannot.
picks.rationale: Consolidation with a technical thesis attached: deterministic rendering off layout and storyboard data is the counter-bet to text-to-video for long-form continuity.

picks.title: James Gray says the industry's 'obscene' AI push will fail and film will come back like vinyl
picks.excerpt: James Gray, who returned to celluloid and vintage tools on 'Paper Tiger,' predicts the industry's 'obscene' AI push will fail and that shooting on film will stage a vinyl-style comeback. A counter-position piece on craft value as generative tooling spreads.
picks.rationale: The loudest counter-position of the week from a working A-list director, and the argument any AI-forward pitch now has to answer.
